notes.title: Demo is now live!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce the official launch of the free demo for [b]ASBAK[/b]!

This demo showcases one of the main character, Sam, in a pre-designed stage inside a train.
We plan to have 4 playable characters and use procedural generation to create the stages in the full game, so this one is more about showing the thrill of the game rather than the whole experience.

Your feedback means the world to us! Play the demo, tell your friends, and let us know what you think.
[b]Light it up. Put it out. ASBAK begins now.[/b]

notes.title: Asbak is going to be so much improved!
notes.content:
Another new info from Asbak and team! We'll happily to share it with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013467/1649a73a9e5c79518a5efdaf650640f97c4b9f8d.jpg[/img]

Hey'all! Publisher here, long time no see (we hope you're waiting for more for shivering contents from Asbak). After long development of Asbak, we gotta say, [b]it changed a lot of things[/b] (and we mean it), every part of Asbak, but you'll still recognize it for sure.

[h2]What changed:[/h2]

📢 New art
📢 New char design
📢 Changed into 2D animation
📢 Will implement new feature (Psst, co-op especially)
📢 Dialogue System

[h2]What we keep:[/h2]

📢 Genre, it's the same as before
📢 There will be 4 main chars
📢 It's about exorcising the city from paranormal creatures in urban city of Indonesia, 

[h2]Last update from us[/h2]
Asbak will be on Steam Scream Fest 3 (Halloween 2024) from October 28 - November 4, Steam will celebrate the spookiest (and spoopiest) season of the year with discounts, demos, and upcoming releases.

📢 We'll introduce you more with the characters, stay tuned!

We'll update the info, so you won't miss the excitement!

notes.title: Asbak - NEW HOT FIX 0.2.15.2
notes.content:
Another new info from Asbak! Thank you so much for all the feedback so far, which inspired us to develop some improvements and fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013467/012a74c02b25a6f0d483293c974eedf5b7d1ea6f.jpg[/img]

Hey'all! Publisher here, after few days of our first revealed page of Asbak, and also many of you have tried to be the best exorcise, we got some feedbacks that we consider as "Needed to be fixed right now" (yeah, you heard that right). 

So, what is it?

Note: 
1. 📢 indicates a change inspired by community feedback! (Almost everything in this case...!)
2. This update is only for small portion bug fix, and not for additional story or level of the game

[h2]Controller[/h2]
📢 We fixed the controller settings for "keyboard only" when confirming and canceling the menu, and also to avoid the player being stuck when in choosing controller at the first menu
📢 Adjusting gamepad experience and button mapping


[h2]Last update from us[/h2]
As per May 20th 2024, this will be our last demo about Asbak that can be accessed publicly, we'll push forward to full build game and you can expect more about the story, the dialogue, new characters, new items, new features, and more.

We'll update the info, so you won't miss the excitement!

notes.title: Asbak - New patch is coming!
notes.content:
[h2]Here's our first patch in Asbak!! Thank you so much for all the feedback so far, which inspired us to develop some improvements and fixes.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45013467/627fc653bf3e1dbe840adbd048b0c152b3b9c4b8.png[/img]

Hey'all! Publisher here, we would like to introduce you into our world and be the best exorcist to save the city. You know... the demons and stuff like that really... haunting people more frequently. So, we keep improving to make sure you are the best among the best exorcist in Mandraguna LTD.

So, what's the change so far? Very well, look at these!

Note: 📢 indicates a change inspired by community feedback! (Almost everything in this case...!)

[h1]General Gameplay[/h1]
📢 Score system fixed (yeah, previously the score always reset when you change rooms)
📢 Controller mapping (if you want to change by yourself to suit with your playstyle, go to settings)
📢 Controller improvements for better experience
📢 Bug fixes in certain aspects

[h1]Level Design & Environments[/h1]
📢 Bug fixes on the levels (Previously, we locked into a room after defeating the demons, and that's scary)
📢 New items appeared!

[h1]Characters[/h1]
📢 Pak Asep, the old man, now can attack with his summoned guard as normal attack, while attacking by skulls, was set as charged attack/heavy attack that needs energy

[h1]Menu[/h1]
📢 Bug fixes on menu while using gamepad
📢 Choosing menu is even clearer with text background

[h1]Last update from us[/h1]
As per May 20th 2024, this will be our last demo about Asbak that can be accessed publicly, we'll push forward to full build game and you can expect more about the story, the dialogue, new characters, new items, new features, and more. 

We'll update the info, so you won't miss the excitement!
